parameters.query:
WITH input_file AS (
  SELECT $1::text AS drive_file_id
)
SELECT
  i.drive_file_id,
  to_jsonb(d) AS existing_document,
  (d.id IS NOT NULL) AS document_exists,
  d.extracted_data->>'file_modified_at' AS existing_file_modified_at,
  d.processing_status AS existing_processing_status
FROM input_file i
LEFT JOIN documents d ON d.drive_file_id = i.drive_file_id
LIMIT 1;

nodes.name: Buscar por Drive ID
nodes.notes: Devuelve siempre una fila: existing_document queda null para archivos nuevos, evitando que el flujo se corte antes de descargar.

parameters.query:
UPDATE documents
SET
  drive_url = $2,
  file_name = $3,
  drive_path = $4,
  extracted_data = documents.extracted_data
    || jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object(
      'last_seen_at', now(),
      'file_modified_at', $5::text,
      'mime_type', $6::text,
      'processing_decision', 'unchanged_seen'
    ))
WHERE drive_file_id = $1
RETURNING id, drive_file_id, processing_status, updated_at;

parameters.query:
WITH input AS (
  SELECT
    $1::text AS drive_file_id,
    $2::text AS drive_url,
    $3::text AS file_name,
    $4::jsonb AS category_path_json,
    $5::text AS drive_path,
    $6::smallint AS fiscal_period_year,
    $7::smallint AS fiscal_period_month,
    $8::text AS fiscal_period_kind,
    $9::date AS payment_date,
    $10::time AS payment_time,
    $11::numeric AS amount,
    $12::text AS currency,
    $13::text AS reason,
    $14::text AS reference,
    $15::text AS issuer,
    $16::text AS payee,
    $17::text AS user_note,
    $18::text AS raw_text,
    $19::jsonb AS extracted_data,
    $20::text AS processing_status,
    $21::text AS processing_error,
    $22::integer[] AS covered_fiscal_months,
    $23::text AS content_hash,
    $24::text AS content_hash_algorithm,
    $25::text AS drive_md5_checksum
),
category AS (
  SELECT resolve_category_node(
    ARRAY(SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text(category_path_json))
  ) AS category_node_id
  FROM input
)
INSERT INTO documents (
  drive_file_id, drive_url, file_name, drive_path, category_node_id,
  payment_date, payment_time, fiscal_period_year, fiscal_period_month, fiscal_period_kind, covered_fiscal_months,
  amount, currency, reason, reference, issuer, payee, user_note, raw_text,
  extracted_data, processing_status, processing_error, content_hash, content_hash_algorithm, drive_md5_checksum
)
SELECT
  i.drive_file_id, i.drive_url, i.file_name, i.drive_path, c.category_node_id,
  i.payment_date, i.payment_time, i.fiscal_period_year, i.fiscal_period_month, i.fiscal_period_kind, i.covered_fiscal_months,
  i.amount, i.currency, i.reason, i.reference, i.issuer, i.payee, i.user_note, i.raw_text,
  i.extracted_data, i.processing_status, i.processing_error, i.content_hash, i.content_hash_algorithm, i.drive_md5_checksum
FROM input i
CROSS JOIN category c
ON CONFLICT (drive_file_id) DO UPDATE SET
  drive_url = EXCLUDED.drive_url,
  file_name = EXCLUDED.file_name,
  drive_path = EXCLUDED.drive_path,
  category_node_id = EXCLUDED.category_node_id,
  payment_date = EXCLUDED.payment_date,
  payment_time = EXCLUDED.payment_time,
  fiscal_period_year = EXCLUDED.fiscal_period_year,
  fiscal_period_month = EXCLUDED.fiscal_period_month,
  fiscal_period_kind = EXCLUDED.fiscal_period_kind,
  covered_fiscal_months = EXCLUDED.covered_fiscal_months,
  amount = EXCLUDED.amount,
  currency = EXCLUDED.currency,
  reason = EXCLUDED.reason,
  reference = EXCLUDED.reference,
  issuer = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.issuer, documents.issuer),
  payee = EXCLUDED.payee,
  user_note = EXCLUDED.user_note,
  raw_text = EXCLUDED.raw_text,
  extracted_data = EXCLUDED.extracted_data,
  processing_status = EXCLUDED.processing_status,
  processing_error = EXCLUDED.processing_error,
  content_hash = EXCLUDED.content_hash,
  content_hash_algorithm = EXCLUDED.content_hash_algorithm,
  drive_md5_checksum = EXCLUDED.drive_md5_checksum
RETURNING id, drive_file_id, processing_status, category_node_id;

parameters.jsCode:
return items.map((item) => {
  const mimeType = item.json.mimeType || '';
  const sourceKind = mimeType === 'application/pdf' ? 'pdf_scanned' : (mimeType.startsWith('image/') ? 'image' : 'other');
  const reason = sourceKind === 'image'
    ? 'image_requires_ocr_or_vision'
    : (sourceKind === 'pdf_scanned' ? 'pdf_requires_ocr_or_vision' : 'unsupported_file_type_for_text_extraction');
  return {
    json: {
      ...item.json,
      source_kind: sourceKind,
      payment_date: null,
      payment_time: null,
      fiscal_period_year: item.json.processing_year || 2026,
      fiscal_period_month: null,
      fiscal_period_kind: 'year',
      covered_fiscal_months: null,
      amount: null,
      currency: null,
      reason: null,
      reference: null,
      issuer: null,
      payee: null,
      user_note: null,
      raw_text: null,
      extracted_data: {
        stage: 'final_ocr_required',
        extractor: 'ocr_or_vision_pending',
        source_kind: sourceKind,
        drive_path: item.json.drive_path || null,
        category_path: item.json.category_path || [],
        file_modified_at: item.json.modifiedTime || null,
        mime_type: mimeType || null,
        md5Checksum: item.json.drive_md5_checksum || item.json.md5Checksum || null,
        drive_md5_checksum: item.json.drive_md5_checksum || item.json.md5Checksum || null,
        size: item.json.size || null,
        sha256: item.json.sha256 || null,
        content_hash: item.json.content_hash || item.json.sha256 || null,
        content_hash_algorithm: item.json.content_hash_algorithm || (item.json.sha256 ? 'sha256' : null),
        issuer_bank: null,
        issuer_source: 'ocr_or_vision_pending',
        review_reasons: [reason, 'issuer_requires_ocr_or_vision']
      },
      processing_status: 'review_required',
      processing_error: null
    },
    binary: item.binary
  };
});
